_README: No sites are configured, on purpose. Nothing here fetches anything until you add one.
Before adding a site, check two things yourself:
1. its robots.txt permits the paths you want (the scraper refuses otherwise, but check first)
2. its terms of use allow personal, non-commercial reading at a slow rate
Prefer a published feed or API over scraping HTML: it is kinder, more stable and usually
explicitly permitted. An RSS or JSON feed the publisher advertises is the best case.
name     what the UI shows as the source
host     the hostname, shown on every card
type     hackathon | job | internship | news | scheme | event
kind     'feed' for RSS/Atom, 'json' for a JSON endpoint
map      for json only: where the rows live and which field is which
